invariants.name: all_source_text_preserved
invariants.basis: the result lists only differences, so it cannot show that every extracted character was compared; the scorer also does not compare extraction with layout.json; R16's other invariants only rule out false claims

invariants.name: ligature_geometry_not_uniformly_guessed
invariants.basis: the fine-geometry check (browser only) accepts boxes inside the ligature glyph and cannot tell a uniform split from glyph geometry; Node runs check no final geometry

invariants.name: all_aircraft_values_attached_to_original_identity
invariants.basis: unchanged rows produce no card, so the result does not show which old row each new row was matched to; R23's other invariants only catch a reported false value change

invariants.name: same_logical_row_order
invariants.basis: row correspondence and order are not observable in the result; zero cards or equal row counts are not evidence of order
